technique_name: Write a story about given scene.
description: The old farmer trudged slowly through the scorched earth of his once lush and productive fields. There had been a fire here, its damage lingering even though the flames had been extinguished. He looked around at the damage with a heavy heart, thinking of all the hard work and dedication he had put in to making this field thrive.
